Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL218 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
